prompt: In a bustling anime style kitchen, steam rises violently from pots. On the left, a chef with a tall white hat chops onions rapidly on a wooden board. Next to him, a sous-chef in a blue apron holds a silver ladle poised over a simmering stockpot. In the center, a waiter with messy black hair balances a tray of three steaming ramen bowls, looking anxious as he navigates the narrow aisle. To his right, a dishwasher with rolled-up sleeves scrubs a stack of plates vigorously under running water. Behind them, a small orange cat sits calmly on top of a refrigerator, watching the chaos with half-closed eyes. Near the back door, a health inspector in a gray suit points sternly at a cluttered shelf while holding a clipboard. The chef hands a fresh bundle of green herbs to the sous-chef, who accepts them with a nod. The waiter looks at the dishwasher, signaling for more clean plates. There is no fire visible in the scene.
